Kernel.RewriteCertificate.step-sound:
{a = lhs : Tm} {b = rhs : Tm} →
Step lhs rhs → (ρ : Env) → eval lhs ρ ≡ eval rhs ρ
Kernel.RewriteCertificate.derivation-sound:
{a = lhs : Tm} {b = rhs : Tm} →
Derivation lhs rhs → (ρ : Env) → eval lhs ρ ≡ eval rhs ρ
Kernel.RewriteCertificate.eval-subVar:
(lhs rhs : Tm) (ρ : Env) →
eval (subVar lhs rhs) ρ ≡ eval rhs (setX (eval lhs ρ) ρ)
Kernel.RewriteCertificate.hyp-step-sound:
{ihL = lhs : Tm} {ihR = rhs : Tm} {a = ρ : Tm} {b : Tm} →
HypStep lhs rhs ρ b →
(ρ₁ : Env) → eval lhs ρ₁ ≡ eval rhs ρ₁ → eval ρ ρ₁ ≡ eval b ρ₁
Kernel.RewriteCertificate.hyp-derivation-sound:
{ihL = lhs : Tm} {ihR = rhs : Tm} {a = ρ : Tm} {b : Tm} →
HypDerivation lhs rhs ρ b →
(ρ₁ : Env) → eval lhs ρ₁ ≡ eval rhs ρ₁ → eval ρ ρ₁ ≡ eval b ρ₁
Kernel.RewriteCertificate.induction-sound:
{lhs rhs : Tm} →
InductionCertificate lhs rhs → (ρ : Env) → eval lhs ρ ≡ eval rhs ρ
Kernel.RewriteCertificate.accepted-sound: (lhs : Env) → eval (add var (suc zero)) lhs ≡ eval (suc var) lhs
